subject: GCP Marketplace: procurement kickoff + billing SKU mapping for DataWave
messages:
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Jamie Green <jamie@datawave.io>; Procurement Team <procure@datawave.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GCP Marketplace: procurement kickoff + billing SKU mapping for DataWave

Hi Jamie / DataWave procurement team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your marketplace listing. Per our earlier call, we'd like to set up a short kickoff to align on two things that will unblock the GCP listing and procurement flow:

1) Billing SKU mapping — how your purchasing system will see the SKU and what to map to in GCP billing exports.
2) Procurement paperwork & SOW signoff timeline — approvals, PO routing, and DocuSign expectations.

Proposed agenda (30 minutes):
- Introductions and roles (5m)
- Walk through draft SOW & pricing table (10m)
- Review procurement questionnaire items and required attachments (10m)
- Next steps and owners (5m)

Available slots (PST):
- Today 2:00–2:30pm
- Tomorrow 10:00–10:30am
- Tomorrow 3:00–3:30pm

I attached the SOW draft and our procurement questionnaire so you can skim beforehand. Marissa will own the DocuSign flow and Karthik will handle the billing SKU mapping.

Jamie — prefer one of the tomorrow slots?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: DataWave_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf), procurement_questionnaire.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Jamie Green <jamie@datawave.io>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@datawave.io>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace: procurement kickoff + billing SKU mapping for DataWave

Thanks Jordan — tomorrow 10:00–10:30am works for us.

Quick notes before the call:
- Our procurement lead Ellen Park will join; she usually needs a cost center mapping and an SKU code that can be referenced on the PO.
- We run a central billing export into our ERP on a daily cadence; ideally the SKU mapping is stable across quarter boundaries.
- For the SOW: can you confirm whether the listed billing cadence is monthly or usage-based? Our legal prefers fixed-monthly where possible.

See you tomorrow — please send a calendar invite.

—Jamie
Head of Partnerships | DataWave Inc
jamie@datawave.io

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Jamie Green <jamie@datawave.io>, Procurement Team <procure@datawave.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-28T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace: procurement kickoff + billing SKU mapping for DataWave

Great — calendar invite sent for Apr 29 10:00am PT. Link: https://meet.redwood/abc-123

Quick answers to Jamie's questions so the call can be efficient:
- Billing cadence: we support both monthly fixed SKU and usage-based metered SKUs. For marketplace listing we typically publish a per-unit price (monthly) and provide metered usage as an additional offer. If DataWave wants simpler procurement, we can make the listing a fixed-monthly SKU and expose usage variants behind the scenes.
- SKU stability: Karthik, can you confirm the SKU naming convention we'll propose so DataWave can lock their mapping?

Action owners:
- Marissa: lead DocuSign + SOW finalization
- Karthik: prepare proposed GCP SKU file (gcp_billing_sku_mapping.csv) and a short note on how it appears in billing exports
- Jordan: host the kickoff and capture PO routing requirements

Attachments (for pre-read): DataWave_SOW_v1.pdf, procurement_questionnaire.xlsx

Jordan

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Jamie Green <jamie@datawave.io>, Procurement Team <procure@datawave.io>
Date: 2027-04-28T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace: procurement kickoff + billing SKU mapping for DataWave

Adding the preliminary SKU mapping idea here so Jamie / Ellen have something to react to during the call. Attached is a CSV with three rows for the proposed offers:
- REDWOOD-GCP-MON-BASE: monthly per-seat (fixed)
- REDWOOD-GCP-USG-1: metered usage (per-token)
- REDWOOD-GCP-BUNDLE-STD: bundle (monthly + metered overflow)

Notes on appearance in billing export:
- GCP Marketplace will show SKU codes under the "LineItemDescription" field in the daily export; customers can map by SKU code or by the ProductDisplayName. We recommend mapping on SKU code for stability.

I'll have the cleaned CSV in the shared drive before the meeting.

Attachment: gcp_billing_sku_mapping.csv

From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-29T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: kickoff prep notes and owner checklist (DataWave)

Marissa / Karthik — quick internal note before the 10:00am PT kickoff with DataWave at 10:00. Key asks to cover: 

1) PO routing: confirm whether DataWave requires Redwood tax jr. or parent company name on the PO (Ellen usually asks).
2) SOW variable: if they prefer monthly fixed, prepare a one-paragraph fallback that explains how overage billing works.
3) DocuSign: Marissa please set the signature block to allow a single signer from DataWave and a Redwood sales manager. 
4) Billing test: after listing publication we'll run a test purchase and confirm the SKU appears in the daily export under LineItemDescription.

I'll run the meeting; Karthik please be ready to share your screen for the billing export example.

Thanks — J

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@datawave.io>
